# statusdrift_monitor (Data Source)

Fetches a single monitor by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the monitor.
- `name` (String) The name of the monitor.

### Read-Only

- `allow_invalid_cert` (Boolean) Whether to allow invalid SSL certificates.
- `cache_buster` (Boolean) Whether to append a cache-busting query parameter.
- `checks_down_to_alert` (Number) Number of consecutive checks that must fail to trigger an alert.
- `connection_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in milliseconds.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `dns_hostname` (String) DNS hostname to query.
- `dns_monitoring_mode` (String) DNS monitoring mode.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is enabled.
- `expected_status_code` (String) Expected HTTP status code.
- `host` (String) Host to monitor (for ping/port monitors).
- `http_auth` (Boolean) Whether HTTP authentication is enabled.
- `http_content_type` (String) HTTP content type.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method.
- `http_post_body` (String) HTTP POST body.
- `http_username` (String) HTTP authentication username.
- `interval` (Number) Check interval in seconds.
- `keyword` (String) Keyword to search for in the response.
- `keyword_negation` (Boolean) Whether keyword match is negated.
- `location_ids` (List of Number) List of location IDs.
- `location_type` (String) Location type (specific or region).
- `locations_down_to_alert` (Number) Number of locations that must be down to trigger an alert.
- `max_redirects` (Number) Maximum number of redirects to follow.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) Monitor group ID.
- `port` (Number) Port to monitor (for port monitors).
- `region` (String) Region for region-based location type.
- `rw_timeout` (Number) Read/write timeout in milliseconds.
- `status` (String) Current status of the monitor.
- `tag_ids` (List of Number) List of tag IDs.
- `type` (String) The type of the monitor (http, ping, port, dns).
- `url` (String) URL to monitor (for HTTP monitors).
- `warning_threshold_ms` (Number) Response time warning threshold in milliseconds.
